title_as_printed: The Solubility of Nitrogen in Liquid Water
pressure_note: 'Pressure, atm.' total pressure measured by dead-weight piston gage; paper does not say whether nitrogen partial pressure or total; gauge/absolute not stated

value.what: X = cubic centimeters of nitrogen at standard temperature and pressure required to saturate 1 g of water (text); y-axis of Fig. 2 reads 'per g. H2O'

volume_basis_evidence: X defined per gram of water, a mass basis (text: 'required to saturate 1 g. of water')
conversion_needs: cm3 N2 (N.T.P.) per g water to mole fraction: N.T.P. molar volume (0 C, 1 atm assumed, not stated for X)
notes: Printed values like .977 kept without leading zero. Row 3 (100 atm, 180 C) has a single experiment so no deviation printed (empty). Averages of replicate experiments.
